requirement: SPEC.md section 7, and the compatibility contract above
note: What each object type declares, what each derived slot depends on, and what each one computes from the slots the object carries. The dependency lists are the part edge derivation and the two integrity checks all read, so a dynamic group that resolved differently in the two engines would leave one of them with a graph that is not total. The text, math and docref types are absent because their schemas arrive with RUST-009, along with the measurer their derived slots read through, and an engine that declared them here would be compared against one that has yet to.
